summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for P1.D Toko Consolidation + P1.A Accessory Cleanup. All 26 tests passed with 100% success rate. Verified legacy collections are empty/dropped and all CRUD operations route correctly to marketing_* and rahaza_* SSOT collections.
passed_tests: Authentication: Login successful
P1.D Verification: All 6 legacy dewi_toko_* collections are empty (unused)
P1.A Verification: acc_items and acc_stock_movements collections dropped
SSOT Verification: All 9 marketing_* and rahaza_* collections exist
Products: GET /api/dewi/toko/products - reads from marketing_catalog_items
Products: POST /api/dewi/toko/products - writes to marketing_catalog_items with _legacy_toko=true
Products: GET /api/dewi/toko/products/{id} - retrieves single product
Products: PUT /api/dewi/toko/products/{id} - updates persist in marketing_catalog_items
Products: DELETE /api/dewi/toko/products/{id} - deletes from marketing_catalog_items
Channels: GET /api/dewi/toko/channels - auto-seeds 8 channels in marketing_platform_accounts
Channels: PUT /api/dewi/toko/channels/shopee - updates persist with enabled=true, fee_pct=2.5
Channels: POST /api/dewi/toko/channels/shopee/sync - creates sync log in marketing_stock_syncs
Channels: GET /api/dewi/toko/channels/shopee/sync-history - retrieves sync logs
Orders: POST /api/dewi/toko/orders - creates order in marketing_orders with field translation (total_amount→total_payment)
Orders: GET /api/dewi/toko/orders - lists orders from marketing_orders
Orders: GET /api/dewi/toko/orders/{id} - retrieves single order
Orders: POST /api/dewi/toko/orders/{id}/status (packed) - updates status and sets packed_date
Orders: POST /api/dewi/toko/orders/{id}/status (shipped) - updates status, sets tracking_number and courier
Returns: POST /api/dewi/toko/returns - creates return in marketing_returns
Returns: GET /api/dewi/toko/returns - lists returns
Returns: POST /api/dewi/toko/returns/{id}/decision - updates decision to 'refund'
Reviews: POST /api/dewi/toko/reviews - creates review in marketing_reviews
Reviews: GET /api/dewi/toko/reviews - lists reviews
Reviews: PUT /api/dewi/toko/reviews/{id}/respond - updates status to 'responded' with response_text
Accessory: GET /api/acc/items - lists 10 accessories from rahaza_materials (type='accessory')
Accessory: POST /api/acc/items - creates accessory in rahaza_materials
Accessory: POST /api/acc/stock/receive - creates stock record in rahaza_material_stock and movement in rahaza_material_movements
Accessory: POST /api/acc/stock/issue - decreases stock correctly (10→7 after issuing 3)
Accessory: GET /api/acc/stock/movements - retrieves movements with domain='accessory'

p1d_verification.legacy_collections_status: All 6 dewi_toko_* collections are empty (count=0), confirming no writes to legacy collections
p1d_verification.ssot_routing_verified: All CRUD operations correctly route to marketing_catalog_items, marketing_platform_accounts, marketing_stock_syncs, marketing_orders, marketing_returns, marketing_reviews
p1d_verification.field_translation_verified: Order field translation working correctly (packed_at→packed_date, total_amount→total_payment, etc.)
p1d_verification.legacy_flag_verified: All documents tagged with _legacy_toko=true for filtering

p1a_verification.legacy_collections_status: acc_items and acc_stock_movements fully dropped (not present in DB)
p1a_verification.ssot_routing_verified: All accessory operations route to rahaza_materials (type='accessory'), rahaza_material_stock, rahaza_material_movements
p1a_verification.stock_tracking_verified: Stock movements correctly tracked with domain='accessory' flag
